Question B-005-001-006.

Why the correct answer is right: Kilo means 1 000, so one kilohm is 1 000 ohms.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "0.1 ohms": This makes kilo a tenth instead of one thousand.
- sourceIndex 2: "0.001 ohms": This makes kilo one thousandth instead of one thousand.
- sourceIndex 3: "10 ohms": This is only ten ohms, not a kilohm.
